mapper.select: select id, width, height, `depth`, segmented, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, pose from seer.annotations where id = #{id};
select distinct id from seer.annotations_epoch_results order by id;

select id, epoch, `time`, train_box_loss, train_cls_loss, train_dfl_loss, metrics_precision_B, metrics_recall_B, metrics_mAP50_B, metrics_mAP50_95_B, val_box_loss, val_cls_loss, val_dfl_loss, lr_pg0, lr_pg1, lr_pg2 from seer.annotations_epoch_results order by id, epoch;

select folder, concat('Det-Fly ', folder) as name, 'BaiduNetdiskDownload' as source, totalCount from ( select substring(id, 1, 2) as folder, count(*) as totalCount from seer.annotations group by substring(id, 1, 2) ) t order by folder;
